GeneratedBy.Name: MNI Open iEEG Atlas processing (source authors)
GeneratedBy.Description: Per source readmes: low-pass anti-aliasing filter at 80 Hz and resampling to 200 Hz (unless already 200 Hz); adaptive power-line removal (1-min set only); visual artifact rejection; per-segment, per-channel mean removal; concatenation of non-consecutive artifact-free segments with 2-s zero buffers; zero padding to a common length (13600 samples = 68 s for the 1-min set; 10 min 18 s / 10 min 26 s for the 10-min N2/N3 set).

GeneratedBy.Name: laneF_convert_ieeg008.py + laneF_split_ieeg008.py (iEEG-NEMAR campaign, lane F)
GeneratedBy.Description: Lossless repack of the source float32 arrays (MatlabFile.mat, NREM-sleep-20min.mat) into BrainVision IEEE_FLOAT_32 per subject/stage; zero buffers and padding detected (all channels exactly 0) and listed in events.tsv. No filtering, resampling or re-referencing.
